REPORT
Date July 20, 19 37

Subject Communication dated 9-7-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Mr. F.G.Holz.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by C Crawford. S.I.

Enquiries show that Mr. Fritz Gustav HOLZ, age
about 45, German, reported to be a retired government official in
the Netherlands Indies, left Shanghai for Germany on March 29,
1937 in the s.s. " Isar".

His last known address in Shanghai is House 38,
Hwa Kee Avenue, 1025 Bubbling Well Road. He was registered with
the "Deutsche Arbeitsfront", 133 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, Room 412,
where he left the following forwarding address:-

C/o Mrs Augusta Mrozeck
An der Bleiche 4
Sensburg, E. Prussia
Germany.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

其在上海的最后已知住址为静安寺路1025号华琪路38号。他曾在圆明园路133号412室的“德意志劳工阵线”注册，并留下以下转寄地址：

德国东普鲁士 Sensburg
An der Bleiche 4 号

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2253.
Confidential.

SHANGHAI, 9 July 1937.
（手写批注：8007 / 16 7 '37）

（左侧页边手写批注：* See also / D 1249/4）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know whether Mr. Fritz Gustav Holz is still residing at Shanghai. Investigations made by this Consulate-General to locate Mr. Holz at Shanghai have failed so far.

Mr. Holz is of German nationality and has resided till March 1937 at 38 Hwa Kee Avenue, 1025 Bubbling Well Road. He intended to return to Europe as he was not able to find an employment here.

Enquiries made at the German Consulate General show that Mr. Holz has not been there for the last three months, and that nothing is known about his present whereabouts.

As Mr. Holz was in financial difficulties it is possible that he has left for Manilla or another place in the Far East.

Your assistance in this matter would be highly appreciated.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕

Acting Consul-General.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA

第 2253 号。
机密。

上海，1937年7月9日。
（手写批注：8007 / 37年7月16日）

（左侧页边手写批注：* 另见 / D 1249/4）

先生：

谨此告知，如蒙告知 Fritz Gustav Holz 先生是否仍居住于上海，本人将不胜感激。本总领事馆为寻找在上海的 Holz 先生所进行的调查迄今未果。

Holz 先生系德国国籍，直至1937年3月一直居住于静安寺路1025号华琪路38号。因未能在本地找到工作，他打算返回欧洲。

向德国总领事馆查询显示，近三个月来未见 Holz 先生到访，且对其目前下落一无所知。

鉴于 Holz 先生经济困难，他可能已前往马尼拉或远东其他地方。

如蒙在此事上予以协助，将不胜感激。

谨致

敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

〔签名〕

代理总领事。

警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，

上海。
